company.name: Sichuan Nadoumi Education Consulting Co., Ltd.

history.title: Our History
history.content: Founded in 2014 and rooted in Sichuan, 四川纳豆米教育咨询有限公司, Sichuan Nadoumi Education Consulting Co., Ltd. has built a trusted reputation over more than a decade by focusing on scholarship acquisition, study planning and education consulting services. Since entering the market, we have been committed to helping students access funding opportunities, optimize academic pathways and achieve higher education goals. With professional guidance, personalized planning and stable industry cooperation, we have supported thousands of students to obtain scholarships and enter ideal institutions, becoming a reliable partner for families and learners in the region.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: Our mission is to empower students with scholarship opportunities and clear educational paths, to provide professional, tailored and results-driven education consulting services, and to help more learners reduce financial pressure, realize academic dreams and embrace a brighter future. We uphold integrity, professionalism and student-centered values, continuously improving our service system to create real value for students, families and the education community.
